description: For engine plugins, and for you when the user chose to bring the sounds only through the conversation (save each sound to its suggested path, next to its scene; never before that choice): the game's CHOSEN sounds in the neutral manifest format (gomo-sounds/manifest@1), each with a download link valid for 24 hours and the suggested path in the project. To hand the user a ready .zip, use export_game. An event with more than one sound (e.g. 3 sword hits) must be played by picking one of its files at random each time, never only the first: write the playback code that way and tell the user. Download tools: export_game gives the whole game as one .zip; get_manifest lists every chosen file with its project path (to save them one by one, or for a plugin); save_sound gives one single file.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.
